shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin's price fell sharply to $59,175, triggering over $1 billion in liquidations, driven by geopolitical tensions and ETF outflows.
The overall crypto market sentiment remains in "Fear" with the Fear and Greed Index at 38 as of June 27, 2026.
The US Federal Reserve's signals of a hawkish stance and elevated inflation (PCE index 4.1%) are delaying expected rate cuts, pressuring crypto assets.
Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has suspended certain EU operations due to failing to secure its MiCA license ahead of the compliance deadline.
Upcoming US non-farm payrolls and Eurozone CPI releases are anticipated to increase volatility and create liquidity gaps across markets.
